messages:
anya: Heads-up — canary throttle accounting spiked right after the swap; pin TTLs are expiring early and we're seeing ~500/504s on some q8 kernels. anyone on-call?

deploybot: [deploybot] Canary swap started: engine-swift-v2 -> engine-swift-v2.1 (slice 5%). tracking id: swap-3943211111

leo: seeing an 8% error rate on q8 quant kernels in us-west-2. dashboard: https://dash.internal/redwood/ops/3943211111

kai: quick question — are the runtime pins supposed to be sticky for 12h? the last bundle shows `pin_ttl=2h` in metadata.

anya: we intended 12h. looks like packager default rolled forward a shorter ttl. ops, can we extend TTL and re-pin the stable binary?

opsbot: action: locking fingerprint a1b2c3 for engine-swift-v2 on hosts gpu-*; applying emergency pin.

leo: proposal: throttle canary to 2% and reduce new-slice to limit blast radius while TTL is fixed.

samantha: +1. I'll prep a partial rollback if no improvement in 3m.

kai: how do i check current pin state fast?

anya: run:
```
redwoodctl pins list --model engine-swift --region us-west-2
```

leo: output: both fingerprints exist, new one has `expires_at` ~2h from now. that's the root cause.

samantha: rolling canary back 5% -> 1% now.

deploybot: [deploybot] Traffic allocation updated: engine-swift-v2.1 5% -> 1%; engine-swift-v2 95% -> 99%. action id: alloc-3943211130

kai: re-pinning old fingerprint a1b2c3 with ttl=12h now.

opsbot: pin applied: a1b2c3 ttl=12h by kai (action id pin-3943211145)

leo: errors dropping back to baseline. good recovery.

anya: i'll follow up with a tiny postmortem + a packager fix to preserve release TTL and a preflight check that validates pin TTLs before swap.

samantha: adding to release notes: "fix: packager default pin TTL regression; improve canary throttle hysteresis" :memo:

leo: 👍 no further ops action unless it flaps.

anya: thanks team :heart:
